gen-dafont-origami-gf-lexend-mega: Wide, friendly letters with a body height close to the capitals, each c leaving a visible gap. Lexend Mega is the quiet workhorse here, and Origami's brushed, poured-lead lowercase gives the pair its one loud, unusual voice.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-lexend-peta: Origami draws its letters like a sign-painter's single brush stroke, with a lowercase mass that feels cast in lead. Lexend Peta follows in sans form, its curves never thinning and its tall x-height making paragraphs go down smoothly.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-lexend-tera: Brushy and a bit odd, Origami lays down lowercase like poured lead type. Lexend Tera then spreads out like stepping stones in a plotter-pen line, so the sans text feels measured against that heavy, hand-painted heading.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-lexend-zetta: Hand-painted weight meets cut ribbon here, with Origami's brush strokes holding steady at constant width. And Origami earns its keep when set big and brief, leaving Lexend Zetta's tall, widely tracked letters to carry the rest.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-montserrat-alterna: Contemporary all the way through. Origami's brushed single strokes and lead-heavy lowercase sit beside Montserrat Alternates, whose open paperclip c and chalkboard-tight lowercase make the sans-serif feel crisp and pointed against the heading's loose, painted looseness.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-cascadia-mon: Outrun Future stretches out in wide-spaced, synthwave outlines with a large x-height and short ascenders. Cascadia Mono answers in a compact sans-serif skyline, its curves matching its stems and each letter standing like a pin.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-julius-sans-: Neon-era outlines, spaced far apart. Outrun Future earns its keep when it runs big and short, and Julius Sans One follows with its open-ended curves and wide stretches of white between letters.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-lexend-exa: Outrun Future draws its wide, authoritative synthwave letters as a constant outline you could trace with a finger. Lexend Exa reads easily beneath it, with stubby ascenders and wide curves.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-lexend-giga: Outrun Future's outlines hold a constant width and keep a wide distance between letters, giving it a synthwave swagger. It excels at declaring; Lexend Giga excels at opening each word out.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-lexend-mega: Lexend Mega reads friendly, its letters nearly capital height with visible gaps. Beside Outrun Future's wide outlines, that plain sans stays quietly approachable while the heading carries the synthwave attitude.
